title: A Primer of the Drawn Thread
summary: A first course in feeling the thin thread that joins a deed to its outcome and in pulling it a little to one side.

title: Handbook of the First Omen
summary: A handbook of small signs that go before a blow or a fall and of the quick answers a student can make once the sign is read.

title: The Fortune Cultivator's Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book for the first season of fate work that trains the cast lot and the screen of odds in a fixed order of practice.

title: A Beginner's Course in Probable Things
summary: A short course in weighing which outcome is likely and in leaning the body toward it before the moment arrives.
